verdict.rationale: Consensus is an AI research SaaS that stores user libraries and threads, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing about retention settings, deletion controls, or data-handling policies. The library import, API and org account-management items are adjacent features and do not show retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
